title: DNA Interaction with Coordination Compounds of Cd(II)containing 1,10-Phenanthroline.
authors: Kasyanenko, Nina; Belyi, Eugeny; Silanteva, Irina; Demidov, Victor; Komolkin, Andrei
one_liner_zh: 该文实验研究镉配位化合物与DNA的沟槽结合和嵌入作用，虽涉及DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主，仅初步计算机建模，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: The experimental study of the DNA interaction with three cadmium coordination compounds [Cd(phen)(3)](CH(3)CO(2))(2), [Cd(phen)(2)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(2), and [Cd(2)(phen)(4)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(4) was carried out using spectrophotometry, viscosity, and dynamic light scattering methods. The role of the solution ionic strength (concentration of NaCl) was analyzed. All compounds can penetrate (fully or partly) to the major or minor DNA grooves. It was shown that, in addition to the important role of electrostatic interactions in the formation of the complex, intercalation of the 1,10-phenanthroline ligand occurs for compounds [Cd(phen)(2)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(2) and [Cd(2)(phen)(4)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(4). Compound [Cd(phen)(3)](CH(3)CO(2))(2) binds to DNA externally. The coordination bond between cadmium and DNA was formed in DNA complexes with [Cd(2)(phen)(4)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(4). Preliminary computer modeling of the DNA interaction with the compounds used was performed.
abstract_zh: 采用分光光度法、粘度法和动态光散射法，实验研究了三种镉配位化合物[Cd(phen)(3)](CH(3)CO(2))(2)、[Cd(phen)(2)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(2)和[Cd(2)(phen)(4)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(4)与DNA的相互作用。分析了溶液离子强度（NaCl浓度）的作用。所有化合物均可（完全或部分）穿透DNA的大沟或小沟。研究表明，除了静电相互作用在复合物形成中的重要作用外，对于[Cd(phen)(2)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(2)和[Cd(2)(phen)(4)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(4)化合物，还发生了1,10-菲咯啉配体的嵌入作用。化合物[Cd(phen)(3)](CH(3)CO(2))(2)则与DNA外部结合。在[Cd(2)(phen)(4)(H(2)O)(2)](CH(3)CO(2))(4)与DNA的复合物中，形成了镉与DNA之间的配位键。此外，还进行了所用化合物与DNA相互作用的初步计算机模拟。
